newsitem.title: USA: Check Technology Q1 net down on sales drop.
newsitem.headline: Check Technology Q1 net down on sales drop.

text.p: Check Technology Corp said Wednesday net income in the first quarter ended December 31 was adversely affected by lower hardware sales.
The company reported earnings of $100,000 in the period, significantly lower than the $552,000 reported one year ago. Sales fell to $5.5 million from $6.3 million in 1995.
Check Technology also announced a delay in beta testing of its Imaggia print production system because of upgrades. The company expects to begin full production in fiscal 1997.
Check Technology develops print production systems for financial and forms printers in 47 countries.
Its shares were trading up 5/8 Wednesday at 6-7/8.
